title: Projection invariance: an integer multiplicity triple carried by a subspace V is fixed by the orthogonal projection onto V (supplied step 1, q_#T = T)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, let V ⊆ ℝ^P be a linear subspace with orthogonal projection q := V.starProjection, and let R = (M, θ, ξ) be an integer multiplicity triple in ℝ^P (IMRep univ m) whose weight measure μ_R = R.measure = θ·H^m⌞M gives no mass to ℝ^P ∖ V. Then for every m-form ω : ℝ^P → Λ^m(ℝ^P) (no smoothness, support or integrability assumption) R.action(q^#ω) = R.action(ω), where q^#ω = affinePullbackForm q 0 ω, (q^#ω)(x) = ω(0 + q x)∘Λ^m q, and R.action(η) = ∫_M θ(x)·ξ(x)(η(x)) dH^m(x). (This is q_#τ(M, θ, ξ) = τ(M, θ, ξ), supplied step 1.)
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m) (V : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), R.measure ((V : Set (Euclid P))ᶜ) = 0 → ∀ ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m, R.action (affinePullbackForm V.starProjection 0 ω) = R.action ω
